notes.content:
Hey All:

This update brings two new, procedurally generated levels. 

You can access them in survival mode and each time your start them, they should have different set-up. 

Thank you for playing!

notes.title: Update #1
notes.content:
Hey All:

This is THE first update for Dinosaur Forest and I hope you will like it.

It is focused mainly on tackling the "repetitive gameplay" and fixing bugs, but it takes some serious change in gameplay course, so really curious of what you think. 

As it injects lots of new content, it can bring some new bug squad onboard - so asking for your understanding upfront. 

I advise to reset your progress (in main menu settings) to get the full experience of what was updated. 

Thanks for playing and appreciate your feedback about the changes.

BTW: This one fixes the missing achievement bug. 

All Hail the mighty T-rex

ANPA.US
